title: factdiff.py anchor --quotes with a repo-relative --file reports every line as no tagged fact instead of naming the path
goal: factdiff.py anchor with --quotes and a repo-relative --file (the article path with its kb root directory prefix) either accepts that path or stops with the 'no file' message it gives without --quotes, instead of reporting each quote line as 'is no tagged fact of the file' (seen in ST-bke44brb: the kb-worker role file writes '--file PATH' and a worker passed the repository path)

run: import subprocess,sys,tempfile,os; f=tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile('w',suffix='.csv',delete=False); f.write('line,quote\n18,OPA separates policy decisions\n'); f.close(); r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/factdiff.py','anchor','--file','kb/public/agents/policy-as-code.md','--quotes',f.name,'--dry-run'],capture_output=True,text=True); os.unlink(f.name); sys.exit(1 if 'is no tagged fact' in r.stderr else 0)

notes: ST-edgkrk37 (2026-10-15): the same message for --file kb/public/agents/agent-sandboxes.md and for the kb-root-prefixed --file public/agents/agent-sandboxes.md (45 lines each reported 'is no tagged fact of the file'); only the root-relative agents/agent-sandboxes.md worked, and staging the new file did not change it. ST-52lihy7z (2026-10-15): again for --file kb/public/gitlab/commit-signing-and-provenance.md (45 quote lines each reported 'is no tagged fact of the file', exit 2); the root-relative gitlab/commit-signing-and-provenance.md anchored 45 quotes. Seen again 2026-10-15 in ST-u6y5okle: factdiff.py anchor --file kb/public/auth/spiffe-workload-identity.md (and public/auth/...) --quotes CSV printed 'is no tagged fact of the file' for all 37 rows; --file auth/spiffe-workload-identity.md worked. kb-worker.md rule 3 and the kb-research skill both say --file PATH / <a topic you edited>, so the repo-relative form is what a worker tries first.
